title: Rastriya Banijya Bank (RBB) 5th Level - Mock Test 1
description: Full mock test based on the latest RBB syllabus for Assistant Level.

questions.questionText: When was Rastriya Banijya Bank established?
questions.explanation: Rastriya Banijya Bank was established on Magh 10, 2022 BS under the RBB Act.

questions.questionText: What is the minimum capital requirement for a Class 'A' Commercial Bank in Nepal?
questions.explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank mandates a minimum paid-up capital of NPR 8 Billion for Class 'A' Commercial Banks.

questions.questionText: Which accounting principle states that a business is a separate entity from its owners?
questions.explanation: The Business Entity Concept assumes that the financial transactions of a business are kept separate from the personal affairs of its owners.

questions.questionText: What is the primary function of Nepal Rastra Bank?
questions.explanation: As the central bank, NRB's primary functions include issuing currency, managing foreign exchange, and regulating other banks.

questions.questionText: Which type of account generally offers the highest interest rate?
questions.explanation: Fixed Deposit Accounts lock in money for a specific term and thus offer higher interest rates compared to saving or current accounts.
